contentBlocks.text: ਅੱਜ ਅਸੀਂ ਲੋਕ ਕਹਾਣੀਆਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਿੱਖਾਂਗੇ। (Today we'll learn about folk tales.) A folk tale is a story passed down through generations, usually teaching a real lesson.

New vocabulary: ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ (peerhi, generation), ਸਿੱਖਿਆ (sikhya, a lesson or moral), and ਬੁੱਢਾ (budhha, old man). Folk tales are told by one ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ (generation) to the next, and almost always give the listener a real ਸਿੱਖਿਆ (lesson) at the end — that's what makes them different from just any story. Read this short story: ਇੱਕ ਬੁੱਢਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿੰਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਸੀ। ਉਹ ਹਰ ਬੱਚੇ ਨੂੰ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਸੀ। (An old man lived in his village. He gave every child a lesson.) What do you think this old man's role in his village was?
ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸ਼! (Well done!) You now understand what makes a folk tale special: it's passed down across generations and always carries a real lesson. Tomorrow we'll read a real, famous folk tale.

objectives: Define a folk tale as a story passed down through generations that teaches a lesson
Learn 3 new vocabulary words: ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ, ਸਿੱਖਿਆ, ਬੁੱਢਾ
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Ask the child if they know any folk tales, from any culture.
2. Introduce the definition of a folk tale and today's 3 new words.
3. Read the short story together, discussing the old man's likely role.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: reading a real, famous folk tale.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just the definition (passed down + teaches a lesson) without requiring all 3 vocabulary words to be memorized yet
Ready for more: ask them to name a folk tale from a different culture they already know and compare it to this definition
All Gurmukhi words/sentences used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਪੀੜ੍ਹੀ = generation. 2. ਸਿੱਖਿਆ = a lesson or moral. 3. ਬੁੱਢਾ = old man. 4. A folk tale is passed down through generations and teaches a lesson.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Introduces the genre concept directly, matching the course's own 'Punjabi folk tales' description, before reading a real example story on Day 2.

generationData.instructions: Write the English meaning of each Gurmukhi word, then answer the last question.

rows.problem: What two things make a story a 'folk tale'?
